signal: After complete regular session: invested if close strictly greater than arithmetic mean of latest 50 complete session closes including current session; else cash.
execution: Next regular-session Alpaca SIP daily open; only targets durably recorded before that open. Buy shares=sleeve_cash/(open*1.001); sell proceeds=shares*open*.999. Fractional shares; daily marks approximate executable fills.
benchmark: Buy all eight at first eligible seed session open, then hold.

data.daily_bar_note: Alpaca daily price fields exclude extended-hours T/U trades; minute and daily condition rules differ. Use daily open/close as frozen, not last minute/after-hours prints.

gates: Read protocol and all existing ledger records before each run.
Require complete unique chronological calendar-matching daily bars, finite positive OHLC and 50 complete closes.
Check corporate actions across SMA lookback and since previous observation. Unresolved adjustment or corporate action issues quarantine; never mix bases or silently adjust ledger.
Observe only complete sessions; timestamp observation and persist next execution session before its open.
Do not invent missed targets. Previously recorded actions and later valuations may be observed later.
Idempotency by session: append a new numbered ledger record only if not already recorded. Never overwrite prior ledger or source snapshot; append correction evidence for review instead.
Verify committed ledger/targets before claiming persistence. Failed ref update means tracking blocked.
storage: ledger/*.json is append-only ordered event ledger. sources/*.json are immutable input snapshots. report.md is a derived view.
